verified_facts.text: Hotel Villa Real is on Plaza de las Cortes, opposite the Congress of Deputies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel Villa Real 5\* is located on **Plaza de las Cortes**, opposite the **Congress of Deputies**

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a few steps from the museum triangle formed by the Prado, the Thyssen-Bornemisza and the Reina Sofia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located just a few steps from the **golden museum triangle** formed by the **Prado Museum**, the **Thyssen-Bornemisza Museum** and the **Reina Sofía Foundation**

verified_facts.text: The hotel's event spaces are decorated with authentic Roman mosaics and Apulian vases from Magna Graecia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Decorated with **authentic Roman mosaics and Apulian vases from Magna Graecia**

verified_facts.text: Guests find a collection of art and antiquities throughout the public areas, including ancient Roman sculptures and mosaics and Apulian vases.
verified_facts.excerpt: Throughout the public areas, guests will find an impressive collection of art and antiquities. Ancient Roman sculptures and mosaics in one corner, Apulian vases in another.

verified_facts.text: Hotel Villa Real is part of Derby Hotels Collection.
verified_facts.excerpt: Part of Derby Hotels Collection

verified_facts.text: The Suites are spread over two levels and each has its own private terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 40m² Suites at the 5-star Hotel Villa Real are spread over two comfortable levels and each features its own private terrace of over 15m².

verified_facts.text: The Grand Suite is on the hotel's fifth floor and has a bedroom, bathroom, foyer and balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: The 56m² Grand Suite, located on the hotel's fifth floor, offers a spacious bedroom, bathroom, foyer, and balcony

verified_facts.text: The Junior Suites have balconies with views of Calle del Prado.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Junior Suites, luxurious 38m² rooms with balconies and splendid views of Calle del Prado

verified_facts.text: Superior rooms overlooking the interior courtyard are very quiet.
verified_facts.excerpt: They are very quiet as they overlook the interior courtyard.

verified_facts.text: Family rooms sleep up to four people over two levels, each level with its own bedroom and en-suite bathroom.
verified_facts.excerpt: The family rooms, accommodating up to four people and spread over two levels, feature a bedroom and en-suite bathroom with shower on the lower level and a double bedroom and en-suite bathroom on the upper level.

verified_facts.text: Dogs receive a kit with a bed, food and water bowls, and toys and treats.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your travel companion will receive a special kit with a **bed, food bowl, water bowl, and a selection of toys and treats**

verified_facts.text: The rooftop terrace and pool are open in summer.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooftop terrace and pool (open only in summer)

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a gym.
verified_facts.excerpt: a fully equipped gym

verified_facts.text: East Restaurant & Bar serves Mediterranean-inspired tapas.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Mediterranean-inspired tapas in a setting of luxury and elegance

East Restaurant & Bar

verified_facts.text: Breakfast includes Spanish cheeses, cured meats and an a la carte menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: Don’t miss breakfast here where Spanish cheeses, cured meats, and an a la carte menu prepare guests well

verified_facts.text: A Guest Relations and Concierge team provides personalized support.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Guest Relations & Concierge team provides attentive, personalized support to care for every detail with the utmost dedication.

verified_facts.text: The staff is multilingual.
verified_facts.excerpt: Service never misses a beat here thanks to a multilingual staff

verified_facts.text: Toiletries are from The White Company.

verified_facts.text: The nearest metro stop is Sevilla on Line 2.
verified_facts.excerpt: The nearest metro stop to the hotel is Sevilla (L2).
